nodes.description: constructor: mints reflection supply to deployer, creates Uniswap V2 pair, excludes owner and contract from fees
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount): calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount): transfers and reduces allowance of _msgSender()
increaseAllowance(spender, addedValue): adds to caller allowance
decreaseAllowance(spender, subtractedValue): subtracts from caller allowance
deliver(tAmount): burns reflection tokens of _msgSender() and adds to _tFeeTotal
reflectionFromToken(tAmount, deductTransferFee): view conversion of token amount to reflection amount
tokenFromReflection(rAmount): view conversion of reflection amount to token amount using current rate
excludeFromReward(account) onlyOwner: adds account to _excluded and snapshots _tOwned
includeInReward(account) onlyOwner: removes account from _excluded array via swap-and-pop loop
setMaxTxPercent(maxTxPercent) onlyOwner: recomputes _maxTxAmount from user-supplied percent
receive() external payable: accepts ETH, notably from the Uniswap router during swaps
lock(time) onlyOwner: clears owner, stores _previousOwner and sets _lockTime = now + time
unlock(): requires _previousOwner == msg.sender and now > _lockTime, then restores owner
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner: sets owner to address(0)
_transfer(from,to,amount): validates addresses, enforces _maxTxAmount, triggers swapAndLiquify and then _tokenTransfer
swapAndLiquify(contractTokenBalance) lockTheSwap: splits balance, swaps half for ETH and adds liquidity
addLiquidity(tokenAmount, ethAmount): approves router and calls addLiquidityETH{value: ethAmount}
_transferStandard: standard transfer updating _rOwned balances and fees
_transferToExcluded: transfer to a reward-excluded account updating _tOwned
_transferFromExcluded: transfer from a reward-excluded account updating _tOwned
_getValues(tAmount): computes r/t transfer amounts, fees and liquidity
_getTValues(tAmount): computes token fee, liquidity and transfer amounts
_getRValues(tAmount,tFee,tLiquidity,currentRate): scales token amounts by current rate
_getRate(): divides reflection supply by token supply
_getCurrentSupply(): iterates _excluded to compute effective reflection and token supply
_takeLiquidity(tLiquidity): credits the contract address with the liquidity portion
removeAllFee(): zeroes _taxFee and _liquidityFee, saving previous values
restoreAllFee(): restores _taxFee and _liquidityFee from previous values
balanceOf(account): returns _tOwned for excluded accounts or converts _rOwned
mapping(address=>uint256) _tOwned: token balances for excluded accounts
IUniswapV2Router02 immutable uniswapV2Router: router used for swaps and liquidity
address immutable uniswapV2Pair: token/WETH pair address
bool inSwapAndLiquify: reentrancy guard flag for liquidity swap
bool swapAndLiquifyEnabled: master switch for auto liquidity
uint256 _maxTxAmount: maximum transfer amount for non-owner accounts
uint256 numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity: threshold to trigger swapAndLiquify
uint256 _lockTime: timestamp until which ownership is locked
msg.sender (exposed as _msgSender()) controls caller identity for transfers, approvals and access control
block.timestamp / now used for swap deadlines and ownership lock timing
External call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with attacker-influenceable pool state
External payable call uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH{value: ethAmount} forwarding contract ETH
Timestamp arithmetic _lockTime = now + time susceptible to miner manipulation of block.timestamp
Timestamp comparison now > _lockTime gating unlock and ownership restoration
initialBalance local (contract ETH before swap) in swapAndLiquify()
newBalance local (ETH gained from swap) in swapAndLiquify()
